Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical SMILES from compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5990' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return distinct rows sorted by compound_chembl_id.
